notes.title: PERFECT MATTER: Post-Launch Patch
notes.notes:
With only a few minor bugs on launch, Perfect Matter is off to a nice smooth start. None-the-less, I've fixed a few little pesky bugs, and dropped some additional cosmetics.

Fixed:
~Game-Pad Controls sometimes showing up for PC users
~Some Keyboard keys select/buy menu items, despite being unintended
~Some steam achievements not unlocked

Added:
+A bunch of new Chromas
+A new Apex Milestone

Removed:
-A buggy steam achievement
